caption: 01 · INTENT — What should happen—and why?. Write desired outcomes for company, name, work in progress, archive, public voice, teaching, licensing, philanthropy, privacy, dependents, and closure in plain language.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what should happen—and why? within The Institutional Will.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · AUTHORITY — Which instrument can make it happen?. Map corporate documents, contracts, employment terms, IP records, wills or trusts, powers, beneficiary designations, data policies, archive agreements, and jurisdiction-specific requirements with counsel.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping which instrument can make it happen? within The Institutional Will.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · STEWARD — Who acts, who substitutes, who reviews?. Name primary and alternate decision-makers by function; address conflicts, expertise, compensation, access, accountability, dissent, cultural authority, and removal.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who acts, who substitutes, who reviews? within The Institutional Will.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · REHEARSE — Does the plan work in practice?. Run incapacity, death, departure, sale, closure, dispute, data loss, platform failure, preservation emergency, and public controversy; record fixes and review dates.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping does the plan work in practice? within The Institutional Will.
